name: ankyrin repeat and zinc finger peptidyl tRNA hydrolase 1

function.text: ANKZF1 is the approved symbol for ankyrin repeat and zinc finger peptidyl tRNA hydrolase 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in catalytic activity, acting on a tRNA; RNA endonuclease activity; cellular response to hydrogen peroxide.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Low-grade glioma; Lung adenocarcinoma; Pancreatic adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: ANKZF1 encodes ankyrin repeat and zinc finger peptidyl tRNA hydrolase 1. The RQC pathway disassembles aberrantly stalled translation complexes to recycle or degrade the constituent parts. ANKZF1-cleaved tRNAs are then repaired and recycled by ELAC1 and TRNT1. It also plays a role in the cellular response to hydrogen peroxide and in the maintenance of mitochondrial integrity under conditions of cellular stress.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ANKZF1 have been reported in low-grade glioma, cutaneous melanoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.
